product.title: North Shore day,Waterfalls and Turtles Tour

description.text: This North Shore day from Honolulu stops at the old Sugar Mill and then walks to a waterfall in Waimea Valley. The drive over includes a history lesson. At the Sugar Mill there is coffee and chocolate, then a souvenir shop. About seven miles later, a three-quarter-mile walk through rainforest and a Hawaiian village reaches a 45-foot waterfall and a pool about 110 feet across, with lifeguards on duty. Swimming is part of the stop before the walk back. Lifeguards are present for the swim at the waterfall pool.
